title: 超大响应被尺寸护栏替换为 RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE 失败信封(截图载荷走专用 hint),仍以 result 投递

provenance.engineBasis: 形状随契约稳定(4.2–4.7);limit 数值随对端缓冲变化,故 error 用 $regex 断言

steps.name: 截图结果超缓冲 → 替换后的失败信封

result.error: response too large for the transport buffer (limit ~1024 KB)
result.hint: The captured image exceeded the WebSocket transport buffer. Retry with image_response_mode:"disk" to save the PNG to disk and receive only its file path, or request a smaller size. Raising mcp_toolkit/limits/ws_buffer_kb in Project Settings also works but requires a reconnect.

error.$regex: ^response too large for the transport buffer \(limit ~\d+ KB\)$

resolves.hint: The captured image exceeded the WebSocket transport buffer. Retry with image_response_mode:"disk" to save the PNG to disk and receive only its file path, or request a smaller size. Raising mcp_toolkit/limits/ws_buffer_kb in Project Settings also works but requires a reconnect.
